title: What are basic Generics in TypeScript and why are they useful?
expectedConcepts: Generics as type variables (<T>) that preserve type relationships
Reusable components and functions that work across multiple types without using any
hints: Think of generics as passing arguments to types, just like functions receive arguments.
Why is <T>(arg: T): T better than (arg: any): any?

codingExercise.instruction: Create a generic function wrapInArray<T>(item: T): T[] that takes any single item and returns an array containing it.
